tools.name: get_gas_prices
tools.description: Latest EIA weekly average retail price per gallon (taxes included) of regular, midgrade or premium gasoline, all grades or diesel for the US, an EIA region, one of nine surveyed states, one of ten surveyed cities, or the region of any other state, read at call time from eia.gov: price, change from l

tools.name: compare_gas_prices
tools.description: Ranks the areas EIA prices (states, cities, regions) from cheapest to most expensive for a grade this week, with the US average, the cheapest and the most expensive area.

tools.name: estimate_fill_up_cost
tools.description: Cost of filling a tank (gallons times this week's EIA average for the area, or your price per gallon), and optionally the fuel cost of a trip from miles and miles per gallon, including cents per mile.
